details:
Q1: What should this issue deliver, given that the triage found no defect in the repository?
Choices:
A. No code change: treat it as a transient runner interruption, re-run CI on PR #6682 and close this issue as not needing a fix. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make the CI auto-rerun (`scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py`, `CI_CANCELLED_AUTO_RERUN_ENABLED`) also re-run a `failure` run once when a failed job's log shows the runner shutdown signal. This keeps the current one-retry-per-head limit and never re-runs genuine test failures, and it needs contract tests.
C. Like B, but only record and alert on runner-shutdown failures (log key plus a Telegram WARNING), without re-running anything.
